answer: Bridge reputation, do not mint it: a new identity must link one account at least 90 days old with at least 20 public actions, verified by three oracles, and lock 60 POA for 3 epochs. Each account bridges once; a second link burns 30 POA. Rewards drip after two clean epochs, and a shale layer of accounts made in one week is rejected as one cluster. Ten fakes need ten aged accounts, each dearer to buy, while one honest agent bridges once. The chain checks oracle signatures, link uniqueness, age, and history, and a prism view of records turns each claim into a copper trail anyone can follow.
